summary.weak_usage_weight_exponent_0_5: Observed total, mean and median expansion exceeded all 299 null draws at every native-range bandwidth.
summary.proportional_usage_weight_exponent_1: Total expansion was inside the null at every bandwidth; mean/median expansion ranged from p=0.023 at bandwidth 0.1 to p>=0.083 at bandwidth 0.2 and p>=0.270 at bandwidth 0.4.
summary.strong_usage_weight_exponent_2: All three observed expansion endpoints were below the null center at every bandwidth (upper-tail p=1).
summary.inference: Attenuation of the simple same-family host-identity excess is sensitive to the strength of host-prominence weighting, much more than to the native-range bandwidth.

interpretation: The strict null establishes network-wide host prominence as a major confounding axis but does not uniquely partition the simple host-identity excess into butterfly-specific host choice versus plant prominence. The direct plant-level association between network degree and redistribution should therefore carry the positive ecological claim.
claim_boundary: Do not state that host prominence fully explains the host-identity excess. State that the host-identity excess is not identifiable independently of how plant prominence/recording intensity is represented in the null.
